admission.justification: Geometry, host reservation and dashboard dock rendering jointly prevent the tray from covering the native message box, with focused placement tests.

applicability: Tray presentation beside a visible document/review or Chats iframe, and the same tray on pages with no visible chat column.
conditions: The first visible registered column dock owns the tray; absent one, the corner dock owns it.
Measured frame-relative composer geometry places the tray bottom above the composer top and reserves the height actually drawn by the pill, line or full view.
The full view is bounded by available room above the message box and scrolls its list; unreadable composer geometry places the tray below the frame with the named notice.
A newly revealed collection uses its compact line unless already expanded; explicit expansion/close does not remove picks.
exclusions: No iframe move, reparent, key or reload is introduced by the dock.
The corner dock may overlay ordinary page content.
Frame creation/preload and ready-channel recovery retain their separate existing contracts.
